hooks.command: file="$CLAUDE_TOOL_ARG_file_path"; case "$file" in */ipc/*.ts|*/preload/*) echo '[IPC-CHECK] Fichier IPC modifie -- verifier coherence 3 couches';; esac

echo '=== GIT-ADD CHECK ===' && cmd="$CLAUDE_TOOL_ARG_command" && paths=$(echo "$cmd" | sed 's/git add//;s/--[^ ]* *//g') && for p in $paths; do if git check-ignore -q "$p" 2>/dev/null; then echo "[BLOCKED] $p is in .gitignore" && exit 1; fi; done && echo 'OK: no ignored files'
echo '=== PRE-COMMIT GATE ===' && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -3 && npm run test -- --bail 2>&1 | tail -5 && echo '=== GATE PASSED ==='
